name: @pi-in-go/pigpen-subagents
description: Go port of pi-subagents: agent and chain definitions, their discovery, the subagent tool's list, get, status, stop, interrupt, resume and steer actions (async runs, the fleet inspector and the async agents view), and single-agent and chain runs through a child pig process (partial: no parallel, workflow or worktree features)
author: Michael Kinsy
